anvil.description: Used to upgrade Trinket stats with Iridium Bars or Ascend with a Prismatic Shard (keep only one material type in inventory when interacting).
config.uniform-chances.name: Uniform Enchantment Chances
config.uniform-chances.tooltip: Gives every available enchantment for your weapon or tool an equal, fair probability of rolling (e.g. Crusader, Vampiric, Generous, Master).
config.randomize-seed.name: Randomize Daily Seed
config.randomize-seed.tooltip: Uses true random rolling instead of vanilla's deterministic daily PRNG sequence, allowing re-rolls upon reloading the day.
config.prevent-downgrades.name: Prevent Downgrades
config.prevent-downgrades.tooltip: Guarantees that re-rolling at the Anvil will never lower your trinket's current tier or stats.
config.iridium-cost.name: Iridium Bar Cost
config.iridium-cost.tooltip: Number of Iridium Bars consumed per trinket at the Anvil (Vanilla = 3).
config.show-messages.name: Show HUD Notifications
config.show-messages.tooltip: Displays a notification banner upon rolling an upgrade or perfect tier.
message.cannot-both: Cannot forge: You have both Iridium Bars and Prismatic Shards in your inventory. Keep only one type to choose an action.
message.need-trinket-in-hand: Hold a Trinket in hand and interact with the Anvil to upgrade or ascend.
message.need-materials: You need {{count}} Iridium Bars to upgrade, or 1 Prismatic Shard to ascend this trinket.
message.need-stack-materials: You need {{count}} Iridium Bars to upgrade, or {{shards}} Prismatic Shards to ascend this stack of {{stack}} trinkets.
message.need-iridium: You need at least {{count}} Iridium Bars to upgrade this trinket.
message.need-stack-iridium: You need at least {{count}} Iridium Bars to upgrade this entire stack of {{stack}} trinkets.
message.need-prismatic: You need 1 Prismatic Shard to ascend this trinket.
message.need-stack-prismatic: You need at least {{count}} Prismatic Shards to ascend this entire stack of {{stack}} trinkets.
message.already-ascended: This trinket has already undergone Prismatic Ascension and cannot be ascended again.
message.already-max-tier: This trinket is already at maximum tier and cannot be reforged further.
hud.reforge-perfect: ✦ Perfect Upgrade! Your {{item}} reached maximum stats! ✦
buff.ascension-luck.name: Prismatic Ascension
buff.fairy-defense.name: Fairy Blessing
buff.spur-attack.name: Spur Fury
buff.spur-attack.desc: Active during critical strike speed boost.
ascension.frogegg.desc: Swallowing monsters drops all loot, with a 45% chance to immediately reset swallow cooldown.
ascension.fairybox.desc: Fairy provides guaranteed baseline healing every pulse (even out of combat), heals nearby allies, and grants +1 Defense for 15 seconds.
ascension.parrotegg.desc: Doubles gold coin drops and grants a +35% chance for bonus monster loot drops upon defeat.
ascension.goldenspur.desc: Increases Critical Strike Chance by +10%, and the critical speed boost provides +3 Attack.
ascension.magicquiver.desc: Spectral arrows pierce through all enemies, and increases Critical Strike Chance by +15%.
ascension.icerod.desc: Striking frozen enemies shatters the ice and triggers an ice blast (deals 30% Attack damage and slows nearby enemies).
ascension.basiliskpaw.desc: Reflects 50% incoming damage back to attackers, and attacks have a 20% chance to lifesteal (heal 3–8 HP).
